topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and overview of the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor signaling pathways.

topics.label: Cellular activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate immune cell recruitment, lymphatic trafficking, and systemic inflammatory responses following pathogen detection.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that resolve inflammation, the processes of tissue repair, and the chronic tissue adaptations that develop when inflammation cannot be cleared.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing for the lecture and previews the next topic.
